purpose: Paint the objects out of three phone backdrops whose blockers #355 removed, so the ground matches the open road around them. Same size (1672x941), lossy WebP.
tool: art/backdrop-paint-out/paint.py <area> <mask>.json <out.webp>: LaMa (big-lama via simple-lama-inpainting, CPU, Apple M5 Mac) on a crop with 96 px of context; only the 17 px-dilated mask is replaced (3 px feathered), the rest of the picture is untouched; saved as WebP quality 88, method 6.
masks: Hand-drawn polygons in full-image pixels (mask-*.json) that cover the whole painted object, not only the ground-base footprint of the removed blocker: the footprint polygon is where the object stands, the crates, tent, car and barricades rise above it.

area8.removed: tent, crate stacks, iron fence, gate post and sandbag wall at the left edge (blocker 'Left near tent and supply perimeter')

elephant-and-castle.removed: wrecked car and the wooden barricades around it (blocker 'Mid-right wreck and barriers ground base')

east-bridge.removed: burnt wreck on the bridge deck with its barrel and brazier (blocker 'Near bridge wreck ground base')

layouts: The depth mask of each painted-out object is removed from layout.json (area8 'Left near tent and supply perimeter', elephant-and-castle 'Mid-right wreck with barriers', east-bridge 'Near bridge wreck'): a depth mask hides a player standing behind the object, and the object is gone.
desktop: Only the phone copy is registered in areas.json; the original backdrop.png/backdrop.webp files are not referenced at runtime and stay untouched.
pins: areas.json and public/world/manifest.json rows for the three layouts and three backdrops; tests/data-areas.test.js pins the new areas.json.
